A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we present a novel approach that transfers the painting style from a head portrait to another while maintaining the facial structures.
we present the first method to transfer the style of a painting to a head portrait without the need of a source image.

we present a technique for painting style transfer that is based on convolutional neural networks, which only requires an example painting, and that it is applicable for head portraits as well as for videos.

it is possible to transfer the style of a head portrait onto a new photograph without any additional information.
